shared_alpha_falsification.folds: five repository-grouped causal folds per cohort

mechanism.latency: all four alphas pass current and majority in both cohorts
mechanism.cpu: alpha 4 alone passes current and majority-Light in both cohorts
mechanism.disk: all four alphas pass current and majority-Light in both cohorts
mechanism.rss: no alpha adds a true positive; each adds false positives

peak_cpu_cores.evidence: alpha 4 passes internal fit folds, but the existing outer resource results used alpha 16 and both structured candidates regress
peak_cpu_cores.decision: retain current; alpha 4 is fit-only and not runtime evidence

sampled_peak_rss_mb.mechanism: Heavy is concentrated in Python test, execution, and install families, but repeatable preexecution argv groups are only about 2-5 percent Heavy. The roughly one-percent base rate requires greater than 50 percent positive precision merely to beat all-Light accuracy.
sampled_peak_rss_mb.decision: retain current; stop MLP, loss, seed, and threshold tuning on these exposed data

disk_read_write_bytes_total.evidence: existing cross-cohort outer development result; Candidate R is at least as accurate as alpha-16 Candidate S in both orientations and has the simpler arbitration

architecture_decision.runtime_status: not integrated in this recovery window
architecture_decision.reason_not_integrated: The task established the per-head evidence boundary and falsified RSS alternatives; it did not produce reviewed multi-head runtime wiring or fresh confirmation evidence.
